title: Sum a Slice
story: A slice is a growable list. range walks it.
goal: Write Sum(xs []int) int that adds every element.
hints: Keep a running total and add each element to it.
for _, x := range xs { total += x }
socratic: What should the total start at?
What do the two names after for mean when you range over a slice?
Why does the underscore work for the index?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Sum a Slice”?
